key_decisions.rationale: Keeps widow, poverty, and exact amount.
key_decisions.before: He also saw a poor widow put in two small coins.
key_decisions.after: He also saw a poor widow put in two small coins.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and he saw also a certain poor widow putting in two small coins.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves abundance-poverty contrast and total livelihood, without praising exploitation beyond the text.
key_decisions.before: For all of them gave offerings from their abundance, but she, from her poverty, put in all the livelihood she had.”
key_decisions.after: For all of them gave gifts from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all she had to live on.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for all these out of their abundance have put in offerings, but she out of her poverty put in all the life she had.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains visual referent, future days, and total dismantling.
key_decisions.before: “As for these things you see, days will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
key_decisions.after: “As for these things you see, days are coming when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be torn down.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “These things that you see—days will come in which not one stone will be left upon another that will not be thrown down.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves warning, false identity and timing claims, and command.
key_decisions.before: He said, “See that you are not led astray. Many will come in my name saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time has drawn near.’ Do not go after them.
key_decisions.after: He replied, “Watch out that you are not led astray. Many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and ‘The time has come near.’ Do not follow them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said, “See that you are not led astray; for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time has drawn near.’ Do not go after them.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps wars, upheavals, divine necessity, and delayed end.
key_decisions.before: When you hear of wars and uprisings, do not be terrified. These things must happen first, but the end will not come immediately.”
key_decisions.after: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be terrified. These things must happen first, but the end will not come immediately.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when you hear of wars and disturbances, do not be terrified; for these things must happen first, but the end is not immediately.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps disasters, distributed locations, terror, and heavenly signs.
key_decisions.before: There will be great earthquakes and, in various places, famines and plagues. There will be terrifying events and great signs from heaven.
key_decisions.after: There will be great earthquakes and, in various places, famines and plagues. There will also be terrifying events and great signs from heaven.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: there will be great earthquakes, and in various places famines and pestilences; and there will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves priority, bodily seizure, religious and state custody, and cause.
key_decisions.before: “But before all these things, they will lay hands on you and persecute you, handing you over to synagogues and prisons and bringing you before kings and governors because of my name.
key_decisions.after: But before all these things, they will seize and persecute you, handing you over to synagogues and prisons and bringing you before kings and governors because of my name.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But before all these things they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, being brought before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps persecution’s witness function.
key_decisions.before: This will become an opportunity for your testimony.
key_decisions.after: This will result in an opportunity for you to testify.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It will turn out for you as a testimony.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Jesus as giver, speech, wisdom, and opponents’ double inability.

key_decisions.after: because I will give you words and wisdom that none of your opponents will be able to resist or contradict.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

key_decisions.after: By your endurance you will gain your lives.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains vengeance, written testimony, and fulfillment.

key_decisions.rationale: Names gendered bodily vulnerability, infants, distress, land, and wrath.

key_decisions.after: How terrible it will be in those days for pregnant women and those nursing infants! For there will be great distress on the land and wrath against this people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those nursing infants in those days! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
